A dark page with a light panel

The whole page is dark, set once on the root element. Inside it sits a panel that switches back to light, with its own form, its own link and its own button.

Light panel

Colors here come from the light tokens, even though the page around it is dark. A link in the panel and some inline code should read clearly against this background.

The panel should still feel like part of one page.

Dark inside light inside dark

A third level goes back to dark. Scopes should nest as deep as the markup does.

Back in the dark page

Content after the panel returns to the page theme. A link in the dark page and a highlighted phrase sit here.
